payload.claim: The 'Notes for the agent' section's description of the `prose` gate names only five rules (em dash, semicolon, contraction, perfect tense, sentence length, docstring-line limit) that new comments/docstrings must avoid, but the actual gate (`.saffron/gates/prose.py`) also enforces a `hedge` rule (should/may/might), a `trailing-condition` rule (mid-sentence if/when), and a `comment-block` length limit (`COMMENT_LIMIT = 2`) that the spec never mentions. The gate will still enforce these regardless, but the spec's own summary of 'the prose gate' is incomplete, and a cell relying solely on that paragraph could still trip an unnamed rule.
